chapters.title: The beginning of knowledge
chapters.summary: Proverbs opens with its purpose: to give wisdom to the young. The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge, and Wisdom calls out in the streets.

chapters.title: Seek wisdom like silver
chapters.summary: If you search for wisdom like hidden treasure, you will understand the fear of the Lord. Wisdom guards you from evil paths.

chapters.title: Trust in the Lord
chapters.summary: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding. Honor Him with your wealth and accept His discipline.

chapters.title: Guard your heart
chapters.summary: A father urges his son to get wisdom above all. The path of the righteous is like the dawn; keep your heart, for out of it flow the springs of life.

chapters.title: Warning against adultery
chapters.summary: The father warns against the seductive woman and urges faithfulness and delight in one's own spouse.

chapters.title: Go to the ant
chapters.summary: Warnings against careless pledges and laziness: look at the ant and be wise. Seven things the Lord hates.

chapters.title: The way to her house
chapters.summary: A story of a young man without sense led astray by an adulterous woman, as an ox goes to the slaughter.

chapters.title: Wisdom's call
chapters.summary: Wisdom speaks: she was with God before creation, rejoicing in His world. Whoever finds her finds life.

chapters.title: Two invitations
chapters.summary: Wisdom and Folly each prepare a house and invite the simple in. The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

chapters.title: The proverbs of Solomon
chapters.summary: Short sayings begin, contrasting the righteous and the wicked, the diligent and the lazy. Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all sins.

chapters.title: Honest scales
chapters.summary: God delights in honest weights. Pride brings disgrace, generosity brings blessing, and whoever wins souls is wise.

chapters.title: Words that heal
chapters.summary: Sayings about discipline, work and speech: reckless words pierce like a sword, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.

chapters.title: Hope deferred
chapters.summary: Sayings about desire, wealth and companions. Hope deferred makes the heart sick; walk with the wise and become wise.

chapters.title: A way that seems right
chapters.summary: Wise women build their homes. There is a way that seems right to a person, but its end is the way of death.

chapters.title: A soft answer
chapters.summary: A soft answer turns away wrath. Better a little with the fear of the Lord than great treasure with trouble.

chapters.title: Pride before a fall
chapters.summary: People make plans, but the Lord directs their steps. Pride goes before destruction and a haughty spirit before a fall.

chapters.title: A merry heart
chapters.summary: Better a dry crust in peace than a feast with strife. A friend loves at all times, and a merry heart does good like medicine.

chapters.title: A strong tower
chapters.summary: The name of the Lord is a strong tower; the righteous run into it and are safe. Death and life are in the power of the tongue.

chapters.title: Lending to the Lord
chapters.summary: Sayings about poverty, patience and family. Whoever is kind to the poor lends to the Lord.

chapters.title: The lamp of the Lord
chapters.summary: Wine is a mocker. The human spirit is the lamp of the Lord, searching the inmost parts.

chapters.title: The king's heart
chapters.summary: The king's heart is in the Lord's hand like streams of water. To do justice pleases God more than sacrifice.

chapters.title: Train up a child
chapters.summary: A good name is better than riches. Train up a child in the way he should go. A new section of wise sayings begins.

chapters.title: Do not envy sinners
chapters.summary: Warnings about greed, gluttony, drunkenness and envy. Buy the truth and do not sell it.

chapters.title: By wisdom a house is built
chapters.summary: By wisdom a house is built. Rescue those being led to death, and do not rejoice when your enemy falls.

chapters.title: Apples of gold
chapters.summary: More proverbs of Solomon. A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver. If your enemy is hungry, feed him.

chapters.title: Fools and sluggards
chapters.summary: Sayings about fools, lazy people and gossips: as a dog returns to its vomit, so a fool repeats his folly.

chapters.title: Iron sharpens iron
chapters.summary: Do not boast about tomorrow. Faithful are the wounds of a friend, and as iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another.

chapters.title: Bold as a lion
chapters.summary: The wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are bold as a lion. Whoever confesses and forsakes sin finds mercy.

chapters.title: Without a vision
chapters.summary: Where there is no vision the people perish. The fear of man is a snare, but whoever trusts in the Lord is safe.

chapters.title: The words of Agur
chapters.summary: Agur confesses his limits and asks for neither poverty nor riches, only daily bread. Every word of God is pure.

chapters.title: A woman of valor
chapters.summary: King Lemuel's mother urges justice for the poor. The book ends with a poem praising a capable woman who fears the Lord.
